info.name: Uniblock Direct Direct Pass-Through API
info.description:
The Uniblock Direct API gives developers pass-through access to provider-specific endpoints exactly as offered by upstream blockchain data providers.

Contact Support:
 Name: Uniblock Support

item.name: Direct GET Request to a Provider

variable.description: (Required) The name of the upstream provider to route the request to (e.g., alchemy, moralis, covalent, simplehash, tonapi, helius, solscan).
(Required) The provider-specific endpoint path to call, exactly as documented by the upstream provider.

request.description: Sends a GET request through to the specified upstream provider endpoint. The response is returned exactly as the first-party provider would return it. If no authentication is passed explicitly, Uniblock will attempt to use the credentials stored in the project associated with your API key for the requested provider.

response.name: Successful response from the upstream provider. The response body format depends on the specific provider and endpoint called.

item.name: Direct GET Request to a Provider with prefix

variable.description: (Required) The name of the upstream provider to route the request to (e.g., alchemy, moralis, covalent, simplehash, tonapi, helius, solscan).
(Required) An optional prefix required by some providers, typically a network identifier such as the chain name or version prefix.
(Required) The provider-specific endpoint path to call, exactly as documented by the upstream provider.

request.description: Sends a GET request to a provider endpoint that requires a prefix in the URL, such as a network name. Some providers require specifying a prefix (e.g., the network identifier) as part of the base URL path.

response.name: Successful response from the upstream provider.

(Required) The provider-specific endpoint path to call, exactly as documented by the upstream provider.

request.description: Sends a POST request to a provider endpoint that requires a prefix in the URL. The request body and any authentication headers are forwarded to the upstream provider as provided.
